about: Full v1 mixture and linked cloud view: nongated cases retain oracle/registry sources, and the deep content's controls are ordinary URL keys. Review 044 repair (owner decision D-1, 2026-11-07): the vertex table and the four endpoint sections sit, unchanged, in closed boxes, and the original optimum paragraph and label line in the Settings box beside tau; every hook is in the DOM, so the cases read them there. The live read-out describes the lottery (the review's copy); the lottery strip and the chart's gap label carry their own hooks (lottery-*, chart-gap). Generic result selectors scope to the main result so the added fixed-order result label has its own family/size.
